description: The roof, the operation, the cousin's wedding, the school fees. Each is real, and collectively they are a claim on everything he earns, forever.
energy_note: Every phone call has a number in it.

aspect: Saying no is the same as abandoning them
description: Declining a request is not heard as a budget limit but as a statement about the family, so refusing costs standing rather than money.
energy_note: No is not a financial answer, it is a moral one.

aspect: He is envied and he is broke
description: The village version of his life is dollars; the actual version is a shared room and a bus pass. Both are true and only one travels.
energy_note: Rich at home, sleeping four to a room.

aspect: VILLAIN SCENE - the photograph of the house
description: They send him a picture of the second storey he paid for. He has never stood in it, and cannot, because of VIS-003. He sets it as his phone background.
energy_note: A house he owns and has never entered.
